result.instructions: Tools for Yousign, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which signature requests are still waiting for a signature, and who has not signed yet?"; "Create a draft signature request for the new supplier contract from our template and add two signers."; "Send a reminder to the signer of the NDA that has been pending for a week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Yousign data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run yousign_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run yousign_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run yousign_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. yousign_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: yousign_list_signature_requests
tools.title: List signature requests
tools.description: List signature requests (contracts sent for e-signature) with their status, name, signers count and dates. Filter by status, name text, workspace or external id. Use the returned next_cursor to read more. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests.

after.description: Cursor: the meta.next_cursor value of the previous page.

q.description: Text to find in the signature request name.

status.description: Statuses to keep, for example draft, ongoing or done. Sent as status[in].

workspace_id.description: Only signature requests in this workspace (workspace_id[eq]).

external_id.description: Only the signature request with this external id (external_id[eq]).

tools.name: yousign_get_signature_request
tools.title: Get signature request
tools.description: Get one signature request with its status, dates, delivery mode, signers, approvers and labels. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}.

signature_request_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

tools.name: yousign_list_signers
tools.title: List signers
tools.description: List the signers of a signature request with each signer's status (notified, signed, declined and so on) and signature level. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}/signers.

signature_request_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

tools.name: yousign_get_signer
tools.title: Get signer
tools.description: Get one signer of a signature request: name, email, status and signature details. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}/signers/{signerId}.

signature_request_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

signer_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

tools.name: yousign_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List the documents attached to a signature request (name, id, page count, status). The file content is not returned. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}/documents.

signature_request_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

tools.name: yousign_get_signer_audit_trail
tools.title: Get signer audit trail
tools.description: Get the audit trail (JSON) of one signer: the events of the signing process with their times. Only possible once the signer has signed. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}/signers/{signerId}/audit_trails.

signature_request_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

signer_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

tools.name: yousign_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the templates of the organization. A template holds documents and fields that a new signature request can start from. Yousign API: GET /templates.

after.description: Cursor: the meta.next_cursor value of the previous page.

tools.name: yousign_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: Get one template: its name, documents and fields. Yousign API: GET /templates/{id}.

template_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

tools.name: yousign_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces of the organization. Use a workspace id to filter signature requests or to create one in that workspace. Yousign API: GET /workspaces.

after.description: Cursor: the meta.next_cursor value of the previous page.

tools.name: yousign_create_signature_request
tools.title: Create signature request (draft)
tools.description: Create a new signature request as a DRAFT. It sends nothing: add signers, then activate it to send the emails. Optionally start from a template_id. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests.

name.description: Name of the signature request, shown to the signers.

delivery_mode.description: email = signers get emails when the request is activated. none = no emails are sent.

external_id.description: Your own id for this request, for matching later.

email_custom_note.description: A note added to the signers' emails.

expiration_date.description: Expiry date-time in ISO 8601, for example 2027-01-31T23:59:59+00:00.

ordered_signers.description: true = signers must sign one after another.

tools.name: yousign_add_signer
tools.title: Add signer
tools.description: Add a signer to a draft signature request. The signer gets no email until the request is activated. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests/{id}/signers.

signature_request_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

phone_number.description: Phone in E.164 format. Required for otp_sms.

locale.description: Signer language, for example en or fr.

signature_level.description: Signature level. Use electronic_signature unless the user asks for a higher level.

signature_authentication_mode.description: How the signer proves identity. otp_sms needs phone_number on the signer.

tools.name: yousign_activate_signature_request
tools.title: Activate signature request
tools.description: Activate a draft signature request. This SENDS the signing emails to every signer. Call only after the user confirms the signers and the document. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests/{id}/activate.

signature_request_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

sender_id.description: The user id of the sender, if the organization needs one.

tools.name: yousign_send_signer_reminder
tools.title: Send signer reminder
tools.description: Send a reminder email to one signer who has not signed yet. Sends an email to a real person. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests/{id}/signers/{signerId}/send_reminder.

signature_request_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

signer_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

tools.name: yousign_cancel_signature_request
tools.title: Cancel signature request
tools.description: Cancel a signature request. Signers can no longer sign it. Use it only when the user asks to cancel. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests/{id}/cancel.

signature_request_id.description: The id (a UUID) returned by Yousign.

custom_note.description: A short note for the record.
